checks.q: Is the cliff period correctly enforced before any tokens are releasable?
Is the linear vesting calculation mathematically correct?
Are revocation mechanics properly implemented for revocable grants?
Is the vesting schedule immutable once created?
Are multiple vesting schedules per beneficiary handled independently?
Is the total vested amount capped at the grant amount?
Are vesting tokens properly locked and not transferable before vesting?
Is the vesting start time correctly set and not manipulable?
